start:
Hi! Tell me what you need, or send a voice message. A project's topic also gets that project's notifications.

/status - what is happening now
/waiting - what waits for you
/tasks - open tasks
/new - new conversation
/stop - stop all agents
/resume - turn off the kill switch
killSwitchOn: 🛑 Kill switch active. {count, plural, one {# run stopped} other {# runs stopped}}. Agents will not start until /resume.
killSwitchOff: ✅ Kill switch off. Agents can run again.

status.title: *Status*
status.tasks: Tasks: {inProgress} in progress · {blocked} blocked · {review} in review

voiceNotUnderstood: I could not understand the voice message.
voiceNotAllowed: Voice messages are not available in this project: they are transcribed by OpenAI, which the project's allowed AI providers do not include. Send your message as text.
fileTooLarge: {name} is larger than {max} MB, the most Telegram lets bots download.

digest.restrictedJournals: Journals of projects whose allowed AI providers keep them out of this summary
